settings.intro: Answers to the questions we get asked most.

settings.question: How many gummies a day?
settings.answer: It depends on the formula: the recommended daily dose is shown on each product page and on the jar. Don't go over it.

settings.question: When should I take them?
settings.answer: [TO COMPLETE for each formula, e.g. Gumis Sleep: shortly before bedtime.]

settings.question: Do the gummies contain sugar?
settings.answer: [TO COMPLETE: sugar per serving, any sweeteners.]

settings.question: Are they vegan? Do they contain allergens?
settings.answer: [TO COMPLETE: gelatine or pectin, allergen list.]

settings.question: Can I take several formulas at the same time?
settings.answer: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before combining several food supplements, especially if you are taking medication.

settings.question: Are the gummies suitable for children or during pregnancy?
settings.answer: [TO COMPLETE for each formula.] Keep out of reach of young children. If in doubt, ask a healthcare professional.

settings.question: How should I store my jar?
How do the 2- and 3-jar offers work?
settings.answer: Choose 2 or 3 jars: the discount applies automatically in your cart, no code needed.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: [TO COMPLETE: delivery times and carriers.] All the details are on the Shipping & returns page.
